name: Yesterday's Crossroads
source:
The story of a man who after being left by the love of his life sees himself on the crossroads to open his heart once more, although there's never a perfect path ahead, we never know what surprises life can bring our way.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/CHAQUINN0]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
一名男子被一生挚爱抛弃后，来到是否再次敞开心扉的十字路口。前方从来没有完美的道路，但谁也不知道，生活会带来怎样的惊喜。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/CHAQUINN0]Patreon[/url]]
